paper.title: Contextual bandits with surrogate losses: Margin bounds and efficient algorithms

settings.name_in_paper: Adversarial contextual bandits with margin (ramp/hinge surrogate) benchmark over a regressor class F
unmapped: benchmark is a class of sum-to-zero vector-valued regressors F: X -> R^K, complexity measured by sequential L_inf/l_inf metric entropy
regret measured against the gamma-margin loss L_T^gamma(f) (or hinge surrogate) rather than true policy loss
the learner knows the margin parameter gamma (chosen in advance)
settings.definition_quote: In the adversarial contextual bandits problem, for each of $T$ rounds, an adversary chooses a pair $(x_t,\ell_t)$ where $x_t \in \Xcal$ is the context and $\ell_t \in [0,1]^K\triangleq\cL$ is a loss vector. The learner observes the context $x_t$, chooses an action $a_t$, and incurs loss $\ell_t(a_t) \in [0,1]$, which is also observed.

settings.name_in_paper: Full-information online learning with vector-valued outputs (adaptive local-norm regret)
unmapped: learner predicts s in S subset R^K_+ (image of surrogate over class G) and suffers <s, l_t>; losses l_t in R^K_+ with ||l||_1 <= R, outputs ||s||_inf <= B
benchmark class G with sequential covering numbers
settings.definition_quote: The online learning protocol is: For time $t=1,\ldots,T$, (1) the learner observes $x_t$ and chooses a distribution $p_t\in\Delta(\cS)$, (2) the adversary picks a loss vector $\ls_{t}\in{}\cL\subset{}\bbR^{K}_{+}$, (3) the learner samples outcome $s_t\sim{}p_t$ and experiences loss $\tri*{s_t, \ls_t}$.

settings.name_in_paper: Adversarial contextual bandits with parametric convex regressor class (Hinge-LMC setting)
unmapped: regressor class parameterized by compact convex Theta in R^d containing unit ball and contained in ball of radius R; hinge(f(x;theta)_a) convex in theta; f(x;.)_a L-Lipschitz in theta; sup ||f||_inf <= B
benchmark is (1/K) times cumulative cost-sensitive gamma-hinge loss
the learner knows gamma, B, R, L (used in tuning eta and LMC parameters)
settings.definition_quote: For this section, we identify $\Fcal$ with a compact convex set $\Theta\subset \RR^d$ ... We assume that $\hinge(f(x;\theta)_a)$ is convex in $\theta$ for each $(x,a)$ pair, $\sup_{x,\theta}\|f(x;\theta)\|_{\infty}\leq B$, $f(x;\cdot)_a$ is $L$-Lipschitz in $\theta$ with respect to the $\ell_{2}$ norm, and that $\Theta$ contains the centered Euclidean ball of radius $1$ and is contained within a Euclidean ball of radius $R$.

unmapped: loss vector is zero for the correct label and one for all others (multiclass 0/1 feedback)
mistake bound against cost-sensitive gamma-hinge benchmark
same parametric convex class assumptions as Hinge-LMC; learner knows gamma, B, R, L
settings.definition_quote: A special case of contextual bandits is \emph{bandit multiclass prediction}, where the loss vector is zero for one action and one for all others

unmapped: losses are random with conditional mean bar-l chosen by the adversary per (x, l) pair
realizability: exists theta* with f(x;theta*)_a = K*gamma*1{a optimal} - gamma
parametric convex class assumptions as in Hinge-LMC; learner knows gamma, B, R, L
settings.definition_quote: assume that for every $(x,\ell)$ pair, $\ell$ is a random variable with conditional mean $\bar{\ell}$ (chosen by the adversary) and $\bar{\ell}$ has a unique action with minimal loss.

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic contextual bandits with hinge benchmark over nonparametric class (SmoothFTL)
unmapped: benchmark: (T/K) times expected gamma-hinge loss of best regressor in F; B = 1
(x_t, l_t) drawn i.i.d. jointly from D
settings.definition_quote: in the stochastic setting, where $\crl*{(x_t,\ls_t)}_{t=1}^{T}$ are drawn i.i.d. from some joint distribution $\cD$ over $\cX\times{}\bbR_{+}^{K}$. Here we return to the abstract setting with regression class $\Fcal$, and for simplicity, we assume $B=1$.

unmapped: context space is a metric space with covering dimension p
benchmark class: all 1-Lipschitz maps from X to Delta(A) (l1 norm on simplex)
settings.definition_quote: let $\Xcal$ be a metric space endowed with metric $\rho$ and with covering dimension $p$ ... we define the benchmark class $\Gcal \subset (\Xcal \to \Delta(\Acal))$ to be the set of $1$-Lipschitz functions ... there is a distribution $\Dcal$ over $\Xcal \times [0,1]^K$.

source.quote: For any fixed constants $\beta>\alpha>0$, smoothing parameter $\mu\in(0,1)$ and margin loss parameter $\gamma>0$ there exists an adversarial contextual bandit strategy with expected regret against the $\gamma$-margin benchmark bounded as ...

source.quote: Suppose ... or that $\log\cN_{\infty,\infty}(\veps, \cF, T)\propto{}d\log(1/\veps)$ (parametric case). Then there exists a contextual bandit strategy with the following regret guarantee: ... $O(K\sqrt{dT\log(KT/\gamma)})$, parametric case.

source.label: prop:entropy_growth
source.quote: Suppose that $\cF$ has sequential metric entropy growth $\log\cN_{\infty,\infty}(\veps, \cF, T)\propto\veps^{-p}$ for some $p>0$ ... $\Otilde((KT)^{\frac{p+2}{p+4}}\gamma^{-\frac{2p}{p+4}})$, nonparametric w/ $p\leq 2$.

conditions: log N_inf,inf(eps,F,T) proportional to eps^(-p) with p >= 2

source.quote: In the finite class case there is an algorithm with $O\prn*{K\sqrt{T\log\abs*{\cF}}}$ margin regret.

results.notes: Margin regret for finite regressor class.

conditions: Pi finite policy class X -> A

source.label: ex:finite_cb
source.quote: When $\Pi \subset (\Xcal \to \Acal)$ is a finite policy class, directly reducing to \pref{thm:chaining_v3} yields the optimal $O\prn*{\sqrt{KT\log\abs*{\Pi}}}$ policy regret

results.notes: True policy regret against a finite policy class (same rate as Exp4).

symbols.p_ent: dimension p of the context domain [0,1]^p

conditions: F is the class of Lipschitz functions over [0,1]^p (sequential metric entropy O_tilde(eps^-p))
regret against margin benchmark (also policy regret against pi_ramp class)

source.label: ex:lipschitz_cb
source.quote: The class of Lipschitz functions over $\brk*{0,1}^{p}$ admits a sequential cover with metric entropy $\Otilde(\veps^{-p})$, so \pref{prop:entropy_growth} implies an $\otil(T^{\frac{p+2}{p+4}\vee\frac{p}{p+1}})$ regret bound.

results.notes: Derived from Prop 5; dependence on K and gamma suppressed.

symbols.Rad_T: max_a sequential Rademacher complexity of F|_a

source.label: ex:rademacher
source.quote: suppose that $\max_{a\in\brk*{K}}\mathfrak{R}(\cF|_{a},T)\geq{}1$ and $B\leq{}1$. Then there exists an adversarial contextual bandit algorithm with margin regret bound $\Otilde\prn*{\max_{a}K\prn*{\mathfrak{R}(\cF|_{a},T)/\gamma}^{2/3}T^{1/3}}$.

conditions: X is unit ball of a Banach space with martingale type 2 (beta-smooth Psi)
F: K-1 stacked linear predictors in unit dual ball

source.label: ex:linear
source.quote: Suppose that $\nrm*{\cdot}$ has martingale type 2 ... Then there exists a contextual bandit strategy with margin regret $O(K(T/\gamma)^{2/3})$.

results.notes: Dimension-independent; smoothness constant of the norm hidden.

symbols.q_norm: exponent p <= 2 of the l_p norm on contexts

conditions: X is the unit l_p ball in R^d with p <= 2, linear predictors in dual unit ball

source.quote: Consider the setting of \pref{ex:linear}, with $(\mathfrak{B},\nrm*{\cdot})=(\bbR^{d}, \nrm*{\cdot}_{p})$ for $p\leq{}2$. Then there exists a contextual bandit strategy with margin regret $\Otilde(K(T/\gamma)^{\frac{p}{2p-1}}\wedge{}K\sqrt{dT\log(KT/\gamma)})$.

conditions: Theta compact convex in R^d containing unit ball, contained in ball of radius R

source.label: thm:hinge_lmc
source.quote: Under the assumptions of \pref{ssec:hinge_lmc}, \lmc{} with appropriate parameter settings runs in time $\poly(T,d,B,K,\tfrac{1}{\gamma},R,L)$ and guarantees $\EE \sum_{t=1}^T \ell_t(a_t) \leq \inf_{\theta \in \Theta} \frac{1}{K}\EE \sum_{t=1}^T\langle \ell_t, \hinge(f(x_t;\theta))\rangle + \otil\left(\frac{B}{\gamma}\sqrt{dT}\right)$.

results.notes: Hinge surrogate regret. Informal statement; the formal Theorem 18 benchmark omits the 1/K factor.

symbols.R_th: radius of Euclidean ball containing Theta
symbols.L_f: Lipschitz constant of f(x;.)_a in theta

conditions: Theta compact convex containing unit ball, in ball of radius R

LMC parameters u, lambda, alpha, N, m as specified

conditions: mistake bound against (1/K) cost-sensitive gamma-hinge benchmark

source.label: corr:bandit_multiclass
source.quote: In the bandit multiclass setting,~\pref{alg:hinge_lmc} enjoys a mistake bound of $\otil((B/\gamma)\sqrt{dT})$ against the cost-sensitive $\gamma$-hinge loss and runs in polynomial time.

conditions: exists theta* in Theta with f(x;theta*)_a = K gamma 1{a optimal for bar-l} - gamma
bar-l has a unique minimizing action

source.label: corr:realizable
source.quote: assume that there exists $\theta^\star \in \Theta$ such that ... $f(x;\theta^\star)_a \defeq K\gamma\one\{\bar{\ell}(a) \leq \min_{a'}\bar{\ell}(a')\} - \gamma$. Then \lmc\xspace runs in polynomial time and guarantees $\sum_{t=1}^T\EE \bar{\ell}_t(a_t) \leq \sum_{t=1}^T \EE \min_a \bar{\ell}(a) + \otil\prn*{\frac{B}{\gamma}\sqrt{dT}}$.

results.notes: Regret through conditional mean losses against the per-round best action.

source.quote: For any fixed constants $\beta>\alpha>0$, hinge loss parameter $\gamma>0$, and smoothing parameter $\mu\in(0,1/K]$ there exists an adversarial contextual bandit strategy $(P_t)_{t\leq{}T}$ with expected regret bounded as ...

symbols.p_ent: sequential metric entropy exponent, log N(eps,F,T) ~ eps^-p

source.label: thm:ftl
source.quote: Suppose that $\Fcal$ satisfies $\log \Ncal_{\infty,\infty}(\veps,\Fcal,T) \propto \veps^{-p}$ for some $p > 2$. Then in the stochastic setting, with $\mu = K^{-1}T^{\frac{-1}{p+1}}$, \ftl\xspace enjoys the following expected regret guarantee ... $\inf_{f \in \Fcal} \frac{T}{K} \EE \langle \ell, \hinge(f(x))\rangle + \Otilde\prn*{(T/\gamma)^{\frac{p}{p+1}}}$.

results.notes: Hinge-surrogate regret. Efficient only given a hinge-loss ERM oracle. The proof uses mu = gamma^(-p/(p+1)) T^(-1/(p+1)) K^-1, slightly different from the statement.
